text: Your shop could lose money to a screenshot. Over 200 shopkeepers already did. Would you spot it?
Payment successful. Green tick. Even a ding. This month police and Poonjob arrested two men for faking it.
Payment successful? Squeaky banknote trembling. I never even left his wallet.
So how do you get paid without paying?
A fake app that copies a real payment screen, sound and all, or an edited screenshot, sometimes
One man in Delhi told police he fooled over 200 this way.
And the trick works best when you're busiest.
A rush, a queue, no time to check.
The screen in his hand isn't your bank.
India runs about half the world's real-time payments.
Never trust a screen. Trust a vault.
So before the goods leave, check your app, not theirs.
Comment, do you check every payment?
